name: Cruxton Compsite Pro Boot
description: A mid-weight construction boot with a composite (non-metallic) toe cap rated for heavier impacts than most steel-toe equivalents at lower weight. Popular on sites where metal detectors or scanning equipment are in use. The upper is dark brown synthetic suede with a padded collar and a Velcro side-panel for quick removal at security checkpoints. Lug sole is aggressive enough for muddy sites but not bulky. One of the better-value boots in its class.
functionality: Composite toe impact protection (exceeds standard steel-toe rating), puncture-resistant midsole plate, quick-release Velcro panel
what_it_says: You work construction or heavy trades and you've done your research. Not flashy, just competent.
story_hooks: The non-metallic toe cap means these pass through security scanners cleanly — useful for someone trying to enter a restricted site unnoticed.
Cruxton's current batch has a manufacturing defect in the midsole plate that's known on job sites but not yet recalled.
